newsitem.title: UK: Serco buys two U.S. units from Setech.
newsitem.headline: Serco buys two U.S. units from Setech.

text.p: Holding company Serco Group Plc said on Friday it bought two Setech Inc subsidiaries that provide air traffic control services in the U.S.

Serco said initial consideration would be $2.1 million payable on completion, with a further $1.0 million to be paid at the end of 1998 if certain performance targets were met. Together, the units, Barton ATC Inc and Barton ATC International Inc, were expected to generate turnover of $10 million and a profit before tax of $600,000 in 1997, Serco said in a statement.
Net assets at the date of acquisition were expected to amount to $1.6 million. The units employ 200 staff at 37 sites in the U.S.
